notes: Jump spool: a ring of light tightening round the ship over 8 frames (blue, then cyan, then white; the dashes close up and streaks fall inward, the core charges at the end). The drive spools for 8 s, so play it at 1 fps (frame = floor(elapsed)) or stretch it with the spool timer; scale it up to the ship (it is drawn for a 4x4-cell ship) and hold the last frame until the flash.
